# Survival International

> Global advocacy organization fighting for Indigenous peoples' rights, territorial protection, and self-determination against colonialism, land theft, and exploitative conservation models.

Survival International campaigns for uncontacted and marginalized Indigenous communities across the Amazon, Africa, and Asia, exposing threats from development, mining, conservation abuses, and carbon offset schemes. The organization amplifies Indigenous voices and challenges decolonization of global institutions and environmental policy.

## Key Topics

- Indigenous peoples
- Land rights
- Uncontacted tribes
- Decolonization
- Territorial protection

## Core Mission & Advocacy

- [What we do - Survival International](https://survivalinternational.org/whatwedo): Mission statement defining Survival International's advocacy for Indigenous rights and land protection
- [Indigenous Voices | Survival International](https://survivalinternational.org/indigenous-voices): Video activism project amplifying direct messages from Indigenous peoples worldwide
- [Indigenous peoples & campaigns](https://survivalinternational.org/peoples): Hub page showcasing Indigenous communities and Survival International's global campaigns

## Decolonizing Conservation

- [Decolonize Conservation - Survival International](https://survivalinternational.org/conservation): Critique of colonial conservation models evicting Indigenous peoples from protected lands
- [Green Genocide - Survival International](https://survivalinternational.org/campaigns/green-genocide): Campaign exposing conservation abuses against Baka people in Congo Basin by major organizations
- [#DecolonizeUNESCO - Survival International](https://survivalinternational.org/campaigns/DecolonizeUNESCO): Campaign critiquing UNESCO's World Heritage model for displacing Indigenous peoples

## Global Land Rights Campaigns

- [Lands and Lives - Survival International](https://survivalinternational.org/campaigns/landsandlives): Campaign addressing systematic land theft from Indigenous peoples including Yanomami
- [Blood Carbon - Survival International](https://survivalinternational.org/campaigns/BloodCarbon): Campaign investigating carbon offset scams harming Indigenous lands and communities

## Uncontacted Tribes Profiles

- [Kawahiva](https://survivalinternational.org/peoples/kawahiva): Detailed profile of uncontacted Kawahiva people fighting for survival in Brazilian Amazon
- [Mashco Piro](https://survivalinternational.org/peoples/Mashco-Piro): Profile of largest uncontacted tribe on Earth defending territory from logging pressure
- [Uncontacted Tribes of Peru](https://survivalinternational.org/peoples/isolatedperu): Overview of uncontacted Peruvian Amazon tribes threatened by oil and logging operations
- [Shompen](https://survivalinternational.org/peoples/shompen): Profile of uncontacted Shompen tribe facing mega-development threat on Great Nicobar Island

## Indigenous Communities & Territories

- [Ayoreo](https://survivalinternational.org/peoples/ayoreo): Profile of Ayoreo people in Paraguay's Chaco region facing deforestation and land theft
- [Guarani](https://survivalinternational.org/peoples/guarani): Profile of Guarani people across South America facing land dispossession and cultural crisis
- [Hongana Manyawa](https://survivalinternational.org/peoples/honganamanyawa): Profile of nomadic Hongana Manyawa tribe threatened by nickel mining in Indonesian rainforest
- [Nukak](https://survivalinternational.org/peoples/nukak): Profile of hunter-gatherer Nukak in Colombia driven from rainforest home seeking return
- [Jenu Kuruba](https://survivalinternational.org/peoples/jenu-kuruba): Profile of Jenu Kuruba illegally evicted from Nagarhole National Park by conservation organizations
